{"id":1658992862,"question_id":2,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 1 month","timestamp":1749495356,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1658992862/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Add Two Numbers","memory":"77.1 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for singly-linked list.\n * struct ListNode {\n *     int val;\n *     ListNode *next;\n *     ListNode() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x) : val(x), next(nullptr) {}\n *     ListNode(int x, ListNode *next) : val(x), next(next) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    ListNode* addTwoNumbers(ListNode* l1, ListNode* l2) {\n        ListNode* head = new ListNode(0);\n        ListNode* curr = head;\n        int carry = 0;\n\n        while(l1 != NULL || l2 != NULL || carry != 0)\n        {\n            int sum = carry;\n\n            if(l1 != NULL)\n            {\n                sum += l1->val;\n                l1 = l1->next;\n            }\n            if(l2 != NULL)\n            {\n                sum += l2->val;\n                l2 = l2->next;\n            }\n\n            int digit = sum % 10;\n            carry = sum / 10;\n\n            curr->next = new ListNode(digit);\n            curr = curr->next;\n        }\n    ListNode* ans = head->next;\n    delete head;\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"add-two-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":666}
